Unpopular opinion: handhelds are better than home consoles.

Pokémon was built for the Game Boy. Trading by link cable turned the playground into a lobby. Breath of the Wild played in bed beats any 4K TV setup. Comfort is a feature. Monster Hunter on PSP turned Japanese trains into hunting parties. Handhelds are social. Agree?
